m1-isolate-round-failure.title: Add per-round fault isolation to run_season + failing-then-passing test
m1-isolate-round-failure.imperative: In scripts/run_season_670.py::run_season, wrap each round's run_circuit_fn(...) call and its subsequent check_round_vocabulary in a try/except. On ANY exception, PARK the round: status='parked', reason=f'round failed at run_circuit: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}', round_idx recorded, and append to parked_rounds (or a clearly-named sibling failure list) -- then continue the loop. Keep the existing empty-driver-grid park path unchanged and distinguishable. Add a new test in tests/unit/physics/pilot/test_season_runner.py (existing synthetic-runner style, no real E) where run_circuit_fn raises for one round (e.g. round 1) and succeeds for the others: assert that round is parked with the exception message in its reason, the other rounds are covered, and run_season does NOT propagate the exception. Write the test FIRST and observe it fail (RED, against the pre-fix run_season) before implementing the try/except (GREEN). Do not touch src/physics/pilot/pipeline.py, frozen sets, stage/gating logic, the panel, join, or fingerprint fit -- scope is scripts/run_season_670.py (run_season loop only) and the test file.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new isolation test written and observed failing against pre-fix run_season -- manual attest
TDD green: try/except isolation implemented; new test passes

constraints: OFFLINE; never write a tracked data/f1_data_*.db
do not touch run_circuit, E, src/physics/pilot/pipeline.py, frozen sets, docs/architecture/*

m2-full-suite-pyright-result.imperative: Run the full pilot unit suite to confirm no regression, run pyright on the touched files, then write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/670-season-run/crew-results/g1-implementer-rework-result.md (slice, files changed, pasted pass lines, assumptions, workflow feedback, map impact).
